name: Build Conformance Gate
pass_criteria: Every merged change traces to a task in docs/architecture/spec/tasks.md
The model call seam count measured with the decide-stage command is unchanged, or the change carries a new ADR
No component exists in the code that the architecture graph does not contain; drift is recorded as a graph change plus an ADR
No secret value appears in the diff (credentials gate)
Build checks named in the repository (lint, typecheck, test) were run and their exit codes are quoted
evidence_sources: the seam-count command recorded in SYSTEM.md, re-run
git diff --stat against the base branch
notes: Agents in this organisation do not write application source. The customer coding agent builds; this gate checks the build against the design.
